# U41: Mark up a screen on a phone and a desktop: draw, add a note, check the picture, say what should change, send

- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `MARKUP`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `progress` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U41

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Rhea, on her north star's page. On a phone she goes to Feedback in More, Send feedback, and marks up the last screen, which takes her back to it; on a desktop with Ctrl+Shift+M.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- The screen as it is now, once its entrance motion has settled: what a markup's picture must match (`settledScreenshot`).
- If on a phone:
  - **Step.** Open “Feedback” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
  - **Step.** Press the “Send feedback” button.
  - **Check:** (`entry`) the “Mark up the last screen” button in the “How is the app working for you?” dialog is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
  - **Step.** Press the “Mark up the last screen” button in the “How is the app working for you?” dialog.
- Otherwise:
  - _Note:_ Escape cancels a markup, leaving the page as it was.
  - Press the Control+Shift+M key.
  - Press the Escape key.
  - **Check:** The markup root (`.markup-root`) goes away.
  - **Check:** (`entry`) the goal’s summary bar is visible (else: Escape did not leave the page as it was).
  - Press the Control+Shift+M key.
- _Note:_ The picture is the screen as it was, in its own fonts: no text reflowed into other text.
- How much of the markup's picture differs from a real screenshot of the same screen, as a share of its pixels: The picture is drawn from a copy of the page that keeps each element's size: in any other font the text reflows and lines run into each other, which shows here as about 1% of pixels (measured at 390 and 1280, light and dark), against under 0.05% when it uses the page's fonts (`pictureDiffers(p, live)`, where `const live = await settledScreenshot(p)`).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `differs < 0.003`, where `const live = await settledScreenshot(p)`; `const differs = await pictureDiffers(p, live)`. Else it says: the picture differs from the screen in {(differs * 100).toFixed(2)}% of its pixels (its fonts fell back?).
- _Note:_ The page is frozen: it doesn't scroll while drawing.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `sheetGone && before.join() === after.join()`, where `const sheetGone = await p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'How is the app working for you?' }).count() === 0`; `const before = await p.evaluate(() => [window.scrollY, document.querySelector('main')?.scrollTop ?? 0])`; `const after = await p.evaluate(() => [window.scrollY, document.querySelector('main')?.scrollTop ?? 0])`. Else it says: the page moved under the drawing ({before} → {after}) or the sheet is in the picture.
- _Note:_ A box round the scorecard's last cell, with the mouse (or a finger).
- **Check:** It fails if no scorecard to mark.
- **Step.** Press the “Box” button.
- Drags the mouse across the frozen screen, as a person draws (`drag(p, [cell[0] - 4, cell[1] - 4], [cell[2] + 4, cell[3] + 4])`, where `const cell = await p.evaluate(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.sc-cell:last-child')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r ? [r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom] : null; })`).
- _Note:_ A pen line, then Undo takes it back.
- **Step.** Press the “Pen” button.
- Drags the mouse across the frozen screen, as a person draws (`drag(p, [vp.width * 0.2, vp.height * 0.6], [vp.width * 0.5, vp.height * 0.62])`, where `const vp = DEVICES[device]`).
- **Step.** Press the “Undo” button.
- _Note:_ A numbered note, from the keyboard alone: N, Enter where the crosshair is, a few words, Enter.
- Move the focus to the mk surface (`.mk-surface`).
- Press the n key.
- Repeated, as the code loops:
  - Press the Shift+ArrowDown key.
- Press the Enter key.
- **Step.** Type “Hard to tell which way is better” into the “Note 1” field.
- Press the Enter key.
- **Check:** “Note added” is shown (else: the note was not announced).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “drawing”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Next” button.
- **Check:** The img in the mk preview (`.mk-preview img`) in the “Send the markup” dialog shows.
- _Note:_ The line is needed: Send without it says so, in place.
- **Step.** Press the “Send” button in the “Send the markup” dialog.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert in the “Send the markup” dialog showing “Say what should change first” is visible (else: an empty line says nothing).
- **Step.** Type “Say whether it will hit the target in words I can scan” into the “What should change?” field in the “Send the markup” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “It’s OK” button in the “Send the markup” dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “send”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Send” button in the “Send the markup” dialog.
- **Check:** “Sent. You’ll hear when it’s fixed.” is shown (else: no word that it was sent).
- **Check:** The markup root (`.markup-root`) goes away.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `await p.locator('.goal-bar').first().isVisible() && ticked && /\/help\/feedback$/.test(help || '')`, where `const send = p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Send the markup' })`; `const steps = send.getByLabel(/Include my last 20 steps on this visit/)`; `const ticked = await steps.isChecked()`; `const help = await send.getByRole('link', { name: /What’s sent/ }).getAttribute('href')`. Else it says: after sending: steps ticked {ticked}, help link {help}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `ok`, where `const vp = DEVICES[device]`; `const kept = (await keptMarkups(p)).pop()`; `const ok = !!kept && kept.line === 'Say whether it will hit the target in words I can scan' && kept.mood === 'meh' && kept.route === '/goals/:goalId' && kept.goalId === 'ns-lead' && kept.strokes.length === 2 && kept.strokes[0].kind === 'box' && kept.strokes[1].kind === 'note' && kept.strokes[1].text === 'Hard to tell which way is better' && kept.parts[0].some((path) => path[0] === 'Goal page' && path.includes('Scorecard')) && kept.steps.length > 0 && kept.steps.length <= 20 && ['screen.png', 'ink.png', 'thumb.jpg', 'marked.jpg'].every((x) => kept.pics.includes(x)) && kept.context.viewport.w === vp.width && kept.personId === 'rhea' && kept.demo === true`. Else it says: the markup kept was {a value worked out in the journey}.
- Close this browser.
